description: This file implements a client for managing push notification relay registration, including handling challenges, device attestation, receipt validation, and network requests to a push relay server. It also defines error types and data models related to push relay registration and security.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Handles the receipt refresh process with StoreKit, allowing asynchronous refresh of app store receipt.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Manages the creation of proofs using Apple DeviceCheck App Attest API, including key generation, attestation, and assertion.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Provides the app receipt data, refreshing it if necessary.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main class responsible for registering devices for push notifications via a relay server, handling challenge fetching, attestation, receipt inclusion, and network communication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs the registration process for push notification relay, including fetching a challenge, creating attestations, gathering receipt data, and sending registration request.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Fetches a challenge from the relay server for device attestation.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a specified Decodable type.

methods.name: statusCode
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from URLResponse.

methods.name: normalizeBaseURLString
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL's string representation.

methods.name: decodeErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a user-friendly error message from relay server error responses.
